description: Default release gate. PASS means the recorded evidence satisfies this policy; it does not prove the software is secure or correct, and the release decision stays human.

required_checks.why: Tests must be run by the runtime, not typed in as a claim.

required_checks.suggested_tool: Trivy (pin by commit SHA; never use floating tags)
NVIDIA SkillSpector (a pass is a floor, not proof)
Nuclei / Strix on AUTHORIZED targets only
Microsoft PyRIT, only when the product contains an LLM

required_checks.why: A fresh, read-only reviewer (EGM Goldfish) must have reviewed the review-package.
